meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: Claude 会先反问确认你的需求,再据此新增输入渠道、改触发器、接入 MCP 工具、调整路由或助手人设,改动落在 NanoClaw 的实体模型与配置文件上,并告诉你如何重建、重启与验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加渠道(Telegram、Slack、邮件等)、改触发器、加集成或改路由等自定义时触发;它是交互式的,会先提问弄清你要什么。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个 Telegram 输入渠道
say.note: 它会先问接到哪个 agent group

say.text: 把这条 wiring 的触发规则改成只在被 @ 时唤醒
say.note: 对应 ncl wirings update 的触发器改动

say.text: 给这个 agent group 加上 Gmail 的 MCP 工具

howto.what_en: Claude asks clarifying questions first, then adds input channels, changes triggers, wires MCP integrations, or edits routing and persona files in your NanoClaw project, and tells you how to rebuild, restart and verify.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a channel (Telegram, Slack, email), change triggers, add an integration, or otherwise customize NanoClaw. It is interactive and asks questions first.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel for NanoClaw
say_en.note: It first asks which agent group to wire it to

say_en.text: Change this wiring's trigger rules so it only wakes on @-mentions
say_en.note: Maps to an ncl wirings update

say_en.text: Add the Gmail MCP tool to this agent group
